pages.lesson:
LESSON: MY PURPOSE TALENTS AND ABILITIES

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Creation
Topic 1.1: My purpose Talents and abilities

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on My purpose Talents and abilities. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: what they have learnt, 1. Why is it important to know your talents, gifts and abilities?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify God’s purpose for his or her life to live meaningfully
2. apply lessons learnt from the parable in their day-to-day life

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: MY PURPOSE TALENTS AND ABILITIES
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 5
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
My purpose Talents and abilities helps you succeed in CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: MY PURPOSE TALENTS AND ABILITIES
Study My purpose Talents and abilities like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Identify God’s purpose for his or her life to live meaningfully

What this means
In this part you learn to identify God’s purpose for his or her life to live meaningfully. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: identify God’s purpose for his or her life to live meaningfully.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “My purpose Talents and abilities” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can identify God’s purpose for his or her life to live meaningfully. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Apply lessons learnt from the parable in their day-to-day life

What this means
In this part you learn to apply lessons learnt from the parable in their day-to-day life. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: apply lessons learnt from the parable in their day-to-day life.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to My purpose Talents and abilities in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can apply lessons learnt from the parable in their day-to-day life. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what My purpose Talents and abilities is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “My purpose Talents and abilities” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: identify God’s purpose for his or her life to live meaningfully)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to My purpose Talents and abilities in your own words. (skill: apply lessons learnt from the parable in their day-to-day life)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach My purpose Talents and abilities to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: identify God’s purpose for his or her life to live meaningfully.
3. Practise this skill: apply lessons learnt from the parable in their day-to-day life.
4. Make one local Kenya example of My purpose Talents and abilities from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for My purpose Talents and abilities: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 5 learner study My purpose Talents and abilities?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. what they have learnt, 1. Why is it important to know your talents, gifts and abilities?
2. How do you nurture your talents, gifts and abilities?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what My purpose Talents and abilities means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: identify God’s purpose for his or her life to live meaningfully.
5. Be able to: apply lessons learnt from the parable in their day-to-day life.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
